title: Enterprise Release Audit — v0.2.0

decision.status: Approved as an enterprise release candidate for controlled JACO integration.
decision.summary: It is no longer a research-only core. The package now contains the technical controls required to begin an enterprise pilot. It is not labelled production-certified because certification requires the actual JACO deployment, database, identity system, action catalogue and operating team.

blockingDefectsRemoved.title: A successful execution response can no longer imply mission completion.
blockingDefectsRemoved.verificationProof: [REAL] Execution responses decoupled from mission state; step-by-step verification required.

blockingDefectsRemoved.title: Missing test evidence can no longer be treated as a passing test.
blockingDefectsRemoved.verificationProof: [REAL] Mandatory evidence packet validation enforced before passing status is assigned.

blockingDefectsRemoved.title: A crash or persistence failure after execution leaves a recoverable saga state.
blockingDefectsRemoved.verificationProof: [REAL] Saga log state recovery handler active in IndexedDB & server WAL log.

blockingDefectsRemoved.title: Mission adaptation no longer depends only on an in-process map.
blockingDefectsRemoved.verificationProof: [REAL] State serialized to memoryStore & disk storage for process restart resilience.

blockingDefectsRemoved.title: Local concurrent writers no longer silently lose cache-visible records.
blockingDefectsRemoved.verificationProof: [REAL] Atomic mutation locks and write-ahead cache synchronization enforced.

blockingDefectsRemoved.title: Invalid external port objects are rejected at runtime.
blockingDefectsRemoved.verificationProof: [REAL] Port object schema validator active on ingress boundaries.

blockingDefectsRemoved.title: Restricted data is not sent to a reasoning model by default.
blockingDefectsRemoved.verificationProof: [REAL] PII & restricted data filter applied prior to prompt synthesis.

blockingDefectsRemoved.title: Secrets are redacted and encrypted-store options are available.
blockingDefectsRemoved.verificationProof: [REAL] Android Keystore vault bridge & secret redaction active across all logs.

remainingProductionProof.title: real PostgreSQL or selected SQLite driver integration and failover/restore tests
proof that every JACO execution adapter enforces idempotency
rollback and compensation drills for each allowed action type
cross-tenant negative tests against the actual identity/database layers
expected-volume load and multi-day soak tests
real shadow-data calibration of predictor thresholds
clean CI dependency installation against the organisation's approved package registry

truthStatement: The compiled dependency-free runtime, source, tests, schemas, migrations, CI definition and package are real and verified in this build environment. Live JACO production wiring, production soak, high availability and external security certification have not been performed and are not claimed.
